checks_run.actual: rg4c: build exit 0, drill exit 0, C0-C11 PASS in 65.95 s. C2b: smoke.mjs 10/10 then journey uploads 2 files through the API as uid 10001, 1 synthetic job queued; source store all 10001:10001 0700/0600. C4 copy-out 2 objects. C5 'stderr lines other than Compose progress: none', config.files [compose.yaml, environment.env, images.lock.json], 2 evidence files/2 entries. C6 no group/other bit. C7 initialises the target volume from the app image, C8 runs restore.sh WITHOUT --evidence-owner (the guide's default-owner path) and passes. C9 R7 {owner 10001:10001, verified 2, mismatches 0, otherOwner 0, groupOrOtherBits 0}, uid 10001 reads and hashes both files, same SHA-256 as source, target 'queued synthetic jobs 1'. C10 migrate up to date, /readyz 200 (database, migrations, storage ok, worker alive). finish.err holds only five Compose progress lines (Container … Running/Waiting/Healthy/Creating/Created); the success line appears twice in C5 because the drill echoes finish.out. Failed runs: rg4 and rg4b (source b2864f2ab) drill exit 1 at C2b, journey 'uploads FAIL: no transformation readable by the signed-in user (HTTP 200)'; cause: the drill seeded demo with AUTH_MODE=dev and dev.office saw none of it; a harness defect, not a backup/restore one. Orchestrator edits: 389482803 drops AUTH_MODE=dev from seed-demo; 9b3547113 adds a smoke.mjs call before the uploads (5 lines). Both are harness-only, minimal and disclosed in D-285; I judge them within bounds. Provenance observation (not a finding): rg4c's run.txt and C0 record 'repository HEAD 389482803', which lacks the 5-line smoke step, yet the log shows smoke.mjs output (l.244-255), so rg4c ran on a working tree carrying the uncommitted smoke edit later committed as 9b3547113. Between 389482803 and 2fd69c37 nothing else changed outside docs/delivery, so backup.sh, restore.sh, compose.yaml and the image inputs are the candidate's. The run's evidence is accepted for the candidate on that basis. Residual: no HTTP download through the API after restore (OIDC target, disclosed DO-D14 gap 5); C9 reads as uid 10001 with cap_drop ALL instead.

The Compose drill now moves real evidence (2 files) and a job and the documented restore leaves them owned by uid 10001 with 0700/0600 (rg4c C0-C11 PASS; rg4/rg4b failures explained by the drill's own seeding, fixed by a disclosed harness edit).
